qa.what_happened: The study was abruptly ended after six days, and I was called into a private debriefing with the lead researcher. He explained that the purpose of the study was to observe the psychological effects of extreme compliance and isolation on individuals, with the intention of drawing parallels to real-world scenarios where such behaviors could be manipulated.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I was asked to reflect on my experiences and thoughts throughout the study, which was a stark realization of the manipulation we had been subjected to.
